Authors: Donna Vakalis

DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception Perception3D

dual-arm robotic perception multi-view fusion RGB-D-IR dataset point-to-mesh distance

简要说明：DARP提供了一个校准的双臂RGB-D-IR数据集，包含同步的机器人状态和多视角传感器数据，用于以物体为中心的机器人感知，并通过确定性融合管道验证了毫米级精度。

TLDR: DARP provides a calibrated dual-arm RGB-D-IR dataset with synchronized robot states and multi-view sensor data for object-centered robotic perception, validated via a deterministic fusion pipeline achieving millimeter-level accuracy.

Abstract: Robotic perception from a single viewpoint is often limited by self-occlusion and incomplete surface visibility. This paper presents DARP(Dual-Arm Robotic Perception) https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47, a calibrated dual-arm RGB-D-IR dataset for object-centered robotic perception using two independently moving eye-in-hand manipulators positioned on opposite sides of a shared tabletop workspace. Each arm carries an Intel RealSense sensor that continuously records RGB, depth, and stereo infrared data while synchronized robot joint states are logged for pose recovery. Objects are placed without fixed poses or marked locations, and the acquisition procedure performs automatic localization, cross-arm confirmation, adaptive viewpoint generation, and continuous multimodal recording. DARP contains ten unique tabletop objects and preserves the original sensor recordings, robot-state logs, object-level metadata, and calibration information required to reconstruct camera trajectories in a shared metric frame. To evaluate the geometric consistency of the acquisition, we implement a deterministic multi-view fusion pipeline that converts calibrated RGB-D observations into complementary partial point clouds and measured surface meshes without using learned or generative completion methods. Evaluation on 224 held-out RGB-D keyframes comprising 1,563,466 three-dimensional query points yields a median point-to-mesh distance of 2.13~mm and an RMSE of 4.04~mm, with 96.56\% of points within 10~mm of the measured-surface mesh. DARP is intended as a reusable resource for multi-view reconstruction, collaborative robotic perception, multimodal fusion, active perception, and future learning-based reasoning over partial object observations.

摘要（中文）：单视角下的机器人感知通常受限于自遮挡和表面可见性不完整的问题。本文提出DARP（双臂机器人感知）数据集（https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47），该数据集利用两台独立运动的眼在手构型机械臂，在共享桌面工作台的对侧布设，实现了以物体为中心的标定双目光学-深度-红外（RGB-D-IR）感知。每台机械臂搭载Intel RealSense传感器，在连续记录RGB、深度及立体红外数据的同时，同步记录机器人关节状态以实现位姿恢复。物体放置无需固定位姿或标记位置，采集流程支持自动定位、跨臂确认、自适应视角生成及连续多模态记录。DARP包含十种独特的桌面物体，完整保存原始传感器数据、机器人状态日志、物体级元数据及标定信息，可在共享度量框架下重建相机运动轨迹。为评估采集过程的几何一致性，我们构建了确定性多视角融合流水线，该流水线将标定后的RGB-D观测值转化为互补的部分点云与实测表面网格，无需使用基于学习或生成式的补全方法。在包含1,563,466个三维查询点的224个验证集RGB-D关键帧上进行评估，获得中位点-网格距离为2.13毫米，均方根误差为4.04毫米，其中96.56%的点位于距实测表面网格10毫米范围内。DARP旨在作为多视角重建、协作机器人感知、多模态融合、主动感知及未来基于学习的局部物体推理的可复用资源。

Authors: Manish Kansana, Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar, Sudip Mittal, Shahram Rahimi, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz

GAFT: Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning for Hazard Identification from Rare Failures Other

Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning off-road navigation hazard identification LoRA adaptation vision foundation model

简要说明：GAFT 通过将空间注意力与来自 3D 点云的几何先验对齐，微调视觉基础模型 (DINOv2)，从而提升在越野导航中从罕见故障数据中识别危险的能力。

TLDR: GAFT adapts a vision foundation model (DINOv2) by aligning spatial attention with a geometry prior from a 3D point cloud, improving hazard identification in off-road navigation from rare failure data.

Abstract: Off-road navigation can fail when physical structures induce irrecoverable states such as high-centering or entrapment, requiring human interventions. Identifying these structures is crucial, yet challenging. Such failure events are rare and costly to collect, resulting in limited training data. Moreover, the collected data associate frames with outcomes, but do not indicate the visual cues responsible for the failure. Learning directly from these data can therefore exploit scenario-specific visual cues, leading to poor generalization. We propose \textbf{Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning (GAFT)}, a parameter-efficient method that adapts a vision foundation model with a geometry-derived prior. It guides LoRA adaptation by aligning a spatial attention-rollout map with the geometry prior, while preserving pretrained representations. On an intervention-verified forest hazard benchmark, across ten independently trained adaptations, GAFT consistently outperforms frozen DINOv2 and supervised PEFT baselines, improving the repeated leave-one-scenario-out mean $F_2$ from 0.0607 to 0.3757 with statistical significance under paired analysis. Within these independently trained models, the best-performing GAFT model achieves a repeated-LOSO $F_2$ of 0.570. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/Xu-Yanran/geo_anchored_fine_tuning

摘要（中文）：越野导航中，物理结构可能导致不可恢复状态（如托底或陷入），需要人类干预，此时导航便会失败。识别这些结构至关重要，但也颇具挑战。此类故障事件罕见且数据收集成本高昂，导致训练数据十分有限。此外，收集到的数据仅将图像帧与结果关联，并未指示导致故障的视觉线索。因此，直接基于这些数据进行学习可能利用特定场景的视觉线索，导致泛化能力不佳。我们提出**几何锚定微调（GAFT）**，这是一种参数高效的方法，利用几何先验来适配视觉基础模型。它通过将空间注意力传播图与几何先验对齐来引导LoRA适配，同时保持预训练表征。在经干预验证的森林障碍物基准测试上，跨十次独立训练的适配，GAFT始终优于冻结的DINOv2及有监督的PEFT基线，在配对分析下统计显著地将重复留一场景法平均$F_2$从0.0607提升至0.3757。在这些独立训练的模型中，表现最佳的GAFT模型达到了0.570的重复LOSO $F_2$值。代码与基准测试：https://github.com/Xu-Yanran/geo_anchored_fine_tuning

Authors: Yanran Xu, Chuanhang Qiu, Yue Wang, Wenbo Wu, Zhaoxing Li

SeqAlign3DVG: A Sequence-Aligned Benchmark and Voxel Reasoning Framework for 3D Visual Grounding Perception3D

3D visual grounding voxel reasoning temporal alignment embodied agents depth-free protocol

简要说明：本文提出了一个面向具身智能体的时序对齐图像三维视觉定位基准和体素推理框架。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark and voxel-based framework for temporally ordered, image-based 3D visual grounding, targeting embodied agents.

Abstract: Image-based 3D visual grounding is critical for embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks suffer from loose text-observation alignment and neglect temporal ordering. We introduce SeqAlign3DVG, a novel benchmark dedicated to temporally ordered and strictly observation-aligned image-based 3D visual grounding. Unlike prior works using order-agnostic views or global point clouds, SeqAlign3DVG ensures all expressions are human-verified and strictly grounded in the provided RGB observations (single frames or ordered observation sequences). It comprises 9,622 single-view and 14,493 sequence samples featuring rich descriptions, complex relations, and multi-instance ambiguities. To tackle this benchmark, we propose a unified voxel-based pipeline featuring Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) and Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF). ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.

摘要（中文）：基于图像的3D视觉定位对于具身智能体至关重要，但现有基准存在文本与观测对齐松散、忽视时序顺序的问题。我们提出SeqAlign3DVG，一个专门面向时序有序且严格对齐观测的基于图像3D视觉定位的新型基准。与以往采用无序视角或全局点云的研究不同，SeqAlign3DVG确保所有表述均经人工验证，并严格基于所提供的RGB观测（单帧或有序观测序列）。该基准包含9,622个单视图样本和14,493个序列样本，具有丰富的描述、复杂的关系和多实例歧义性。为攻克该基准，我们提出统一的基于体素的流程，包含相关性有序体素记忆（ROVM）和渐进式语言-体素融合（PLVF）。ROVM通过保守记忆动态排序并聚合多视角证据以减轻噪声观测，PLVF则执行从粗到细的空间-语言推理以实现精确消歧。在无深度协议下，我们的方法达到了最先进性能，显著提升了由复杂关系和外观线索定义的目标定位能力。

Authors: Yi Zhang, Yi Wang, Yueting Wu, Kaiyue Yang, Yuejiao Su, Lap-Pui Chau

Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection AutonomousDriving

tone mapping high-dynamic-range autonomous driving end-to-end optimization real-time processing

简要说明：提出了一种实时场景自适应色调映射方法，桥接HDR RAW输入与LDR sRGB以用于目标检测，实现与下游任务的端到端优化，并在嵌入式平台上实现4K实时处理，适用于自动驾驶。

TLDR: Proposes a real-time, scene-adaptive tone mapping method that bridges HDR RAW inputs to LDR sRGB for object detection, achieving end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks and real-time 4K processing on embedded platforms for autonomous driving.

Abstract: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

摘要（中文）：高动态范围（HDR）图像凭借其丰富的色调和细节再现能力，在增强计算机视觉系统（尤其是自动驾驶领域）方面具有巨大潜力。然而，大多数面向嵌入式系统的神经网络均在低动态范围（LDR）输入上训练，当处理高比特深度的HDR图像时，由于极端动态范围带来的挑战，其性能会显著下降。本文提出了一种新颖的色调映射方法，该方法不仅弥合了HDR RAW输入与检测网络所需的LDR sRGB格式之间的差距，还能与下游任务实现端到端联合优化。我们摒弃传统图像信号处理（ISP）流水线，引入神经光度校准以规范化动态范围，并提出一种尺度不变局部色调映射模型以保留图像细节。此外，我们的架构还支持性能迁移微调，能够以最小代价实现从LDR sRGB图像到HDR RAW图像的高效适配。在具有挑战性的汽车HDR场景中，所提方法优于传统色调映射算法及先进的AI-ISP方法。同时，我们的流水线能够在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现4K高比特深度HDR输入的实时处理。
